039        public static float MAX_REFIRE_DELAY = 1.1f;
040
041        public static float FLUX_PER_DAMAGE = 1f;

043        public static float DAMAGE = 75f;

059        public static String DATA_KEY = "core_ShroudedLensHullmod_data_key";
060        
061        public static class ShroudedLensHullmodData {
062                //IntervalUtil interval = new IntervalUtil(0.75f, 1.25f);
063                float untilAttack = 0f;
064                float sinceAttack = 1000f;
065        }
066        
067        public static ShroudedLensHullmodData getData(ShipAPI ship) {
068                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
069                String key = DATA_KEY + "_" + ship.getId();
070                ShroudedLensHullmodData data = (ShroudedLensHullmodData) engine.getCustomData().get(key);
071                if (data == null) {
072                        data = new ShroudedLensHullmodData();
073                        engine.getCustomData().put(key, data);
074                }
075                return data;
076        }
077        
078        @Override
079        public void advanceInCombat(ShipAPI ship, float amount) {
080                super.advanceInCombat(ship, amount);
081                
082                if (!ship.isAlive()) return;
083                if (amount <= 0f) return;
084                
085                boolean sMod = isSMod(ship.getMutableStats());
086                if (sMod) {
087                        amount *= SMOD_ROF_MULT;
088                }
089                
090                ShroudedLensHullmodData data = getData(ship);
091                data.untilAttack -= amount * getRoF(ship.getHullSize());
092                if (data.untilAttack <= 0f) {
093                        CombatEntityAPI target = findTarget(ship);
094                        if (target != null) {
095                                spawnExplosion(ship, target);
096                        }
097                        data.untilAttack = MIN_REFIRE_DELAY + (float) Math.random() * (MAX_REFIRE_DELAY - MIN_REFIRE_DELAY);
098                }
099        }
100        
101        public static float getPowerMult(HullSize size) {
102                switch (size) {
103                case CAPITAL_SHIP: return 1f;
104                case CRUISER: return 0.6666666667f;
105                case DESTROYER: return 0.3333333333f;
106                case FIGHTER:
107                case FRIGATE:
108                        return 0f;
109                }
110                return 1f;
111        }
112        
113        public static float getRoF(HullSize size) {
114                float mult = getPowerMult(size);
115                return MIN_ROF_MULT + (MAX_ROF_MULT - MIN_ROF_MULT) * mult;     
116        }
117        public static float getFluxCost(HullSize size) {
118                return DAMAGE * FLUX_PER_DAMAGE;        
119        }
120        public static float getDamage(HullSize size) {
121                return DAMAGE;  
122        }

124        public void spawnExplosion(ShipAPI ship, CombatEntityAPI target) {
125                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
126                
127                
128                float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(target.getLocation(), ship.getLocation());
129                angle += 45f - 90f * (float) Math.random();
130                Vector2f from = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
131                from.scale(10000f);
132                
133                float targetRadius = Misc.getTargetingRadius(from, target, false);              
134                Vector2f point = Misc.getUnitVector(target.getLocation(), from);
135                point.scale(targetRadius * (0.8f + (float) Math.random() * 0.4f));
136                Vector2f.add(target.getLocation(), point, point);
137
138                float dist = Misc.getDistance(from, point);
139                
140                //float mult = getPowerMult(ship.getHullSize());
141                float damage = getDamage(ship.getHullSize());
142                
143                if (FLUX_PER_DAMAGE > 0f) {
144                        float fluxCost = getFluxCost(ship.getHullSize());
145                        //if (!ship.getFluxTracker().increaseFlux(fluxCost, false)) {
146                        if (!deductFlux(ship, fluxCost)) {
147                                return;
148                        }
149                }
150                
151                DwellerShroud shroud = DwellerShroud.getShroudFor(ship);
152                if (shroud != null) {
153                        angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(ship.getLocation(), point);
154                        from = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle + 90f - 180f * (float) Math.random());
155                        from.scale((0.5f + (float) Math.random() * 0.25f) * shroud.getShroudParams().maxOffset * shroud.getShroudParams().overloadArcOffsetMult);
156                        Vector2f.add(ship.getLocation(), from, from);
157                }
158                
159                Color color = RiftLightningEffect.RIFT_LIGHTNING_COLOR;
160                
161                if (shroud != null) {
162                        DwellerShroudParams shroudParams = shroud.getShroudParams();
163                        EmpArcParams params = new EmpArcParams();
164                        params.segmentLengthMult = 4f;
165                        params.glowSizeMult = 4f;
166                        params.flickerRateMult = 0.5f + (float) Math.random() * 0.5f;
167                        params.flickerRateMult *= 1.5f;
168                        
169                        //Color fringe = shroudParams.overloadArcFringeColor;
170                        Color fringe = color;
171                        Color core = Color.white;
172
173                        float thickness = shroudParams.overloadArcThickness;
174                        
175                        //Vector2f to = Misc.getPointAtRadius(from, 1f);
176                        
177                        angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(from, ship.getLocation());
178                        angle = angle + 90f * ((float) Math.random() - 0.5f);
179                        Vector2f dir = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
180                        dist = shroudParams.maxOffset * shroud.getShroudParams().overloadArcOffsetMult;
181                        dist = dist * 0.5f + dist * 0.5f * (float) Math.random();
182                        //dist *= 1.5f;
183                        dist *= 0.5f;
184                        dir.scale(dist);
185                        Vector2f to = Vector2f.add(from, dir, new Vector2f());
186                        
187                        EmpArcEntityAPI arc = (EmpArcEntityAPI)engine.spawnEmpArcVisual(
188                                        from, ship, to, ship, thickness, fringe, core, params);
189                        
190                        arc.setCoreWidthOverride(shroudParams.overloadArcCoreThickness);
191                        arc.setSingleFlickerMode(false);
192                        //arc.setRenderGlowAtStart(false);
193                }
194                
195                //float explosionRadius = 40f + mult * 40f;
196                float explosionRadius = RADIUS;
197                
198                DamagingExplosionSpec spec = new DamagingExplosionSpec(
199                                0.1f, // duration
200                                explosionRadius, // radius
201                                explosionRadius * 0.5f, // coreRadius
202                                damage, // maxDamage
203                                damage, // / 2f, // minDamage - no damage dropoff with range
204                                CollisionClass.PROJECTILE_NO_FF, // collisionClass
205                                CollisionClass.PROJECTILE_FIGHTER, // collisionClassByFighter - using to flag it as from this effect
206                                3f, // particleSizeMin
207                                3f, // particleSizeRange
208                                0.5f, // particleDuration
209                                0, // particleCount
210                                new Color(255,255,255,0), // particleColor
211                                new Color(255,100,100,0)  // explosionColor
212                                );
213
214                spec.setDamageType(DamageType.ENERGY);
215                spec.setUseDetailedExplosion(false);
216                spec.setSoundSetId("abyssal_glare_explosion");
217                //spec.setSoundVolume(0.5f + 0.5f * mult);
218                spec.setSoundVolume(0.33f);
219
220                DamagingProjectileAPI explosion = engine.spawnDamagingExplosion(spec, ship, point);
221                
222                //explosion.addDamagedAlready(target);
223                //color = new Color(255,75,75,255);
224
225                float baseSize = 7f;
226
227                NEParams p = RiftCascadeMineExplosion.createStandardRiftParams(

242                RiftCascadeMineExplosion.spawnStandardRift(explosion, p);

244                
245                // the "beam"
246                
247                float thickness = 30f;
248                //Color color = weapon.getSpec().getGlowColor();
249                Color coreColor = Color.white;
250                coreColor = Misc.zeroColor;
251                coreColor = color;
252                
253                color = new Color(255,0,30,255);
254                coreColor = new Color(255,10,255,255);
255                
256                color = DwellerShroud.SHROUD_GLOW_COLOR;
257                coreColor = color;
258                //coreColor = Color.white;
259                
260                float coreWidthMult = 1f;
261                
262                
263//              from = ship.getLocation();
264//              if (shroud != null) {
265//                      angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(ship.getLocation(), target.getLocation());
266//                      from = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle + 90f - 180f * (float) Math.random());
267//                      from.scale((0.5f + (float) Math.random() * 0.25f) * shroud.getShroudParams().maxOffset);
268//                      Vector2f.add(ship.getLocation(), from, from);
269//              }
270                
271                EmpArcParams params = new EmpArcParams();
272                //params.segmentLengthMult = 10000f;
273                params.segmentLengthMult = 4f;
274                
275//              params.maxZigZagMult = 0f;
276//              params.zigZagReductionFactor = 1f;
277                
278                params.maxZigZagMult = 0.25f;
279                //params.maxZigZagMult = 0f;
280                params.zigZagReductionFactor = 1f;
281                
282                //params.glowColorOverride = new Color(255,10,155,255);
283                
284                //params.zigZagReductionFactor = 0.25f;
285                //params.maxZigZagMult = 0f;
286                //params.flickerRateMult = 0.75f;
287//              params.flickerRateMult = 1f;
288//              params.flickerRateMult = 0.75f;
289                params.flickerRateMult = 0.75f + 0.25f * (float) Math.random();
290                
291                params.fadeOutDist = 150f;
292                params.minFadeOutMult = 5f;
293                
294                params.glowSizeMult = 0.5f;
295                
296                //params.glowAlphaMult = 0.5f;
297                //params.flamesOutMissiles = false;
298                
299//              params.movementDurOverride = 0.1f;
300//              params.flickerRateMult = 0.5f;
301//              params.glowSizeMult = 1f;
302//              params.brightSpotFadeFraction = 0.1f;
303//              params.brightSpotFullFraction = 0.9f;
304                
305//              params.maxZigZagMult = 1f;
306//              params.zigZagReductionFactor = 0f;
307//              params.flickerRateMult = 0.25f;
308                
309                Vector2f to = point;
310                EmpArcEntityAPI arc = engine.spawnEmpArcVisual(from, ship, to, explosion, thickness, color, coreColor, params);
311                arc.setCoreWidthOverride(thickness * coreWidthMult);
312                arc.setSingleFlickerMode();
313                arc.setRenderGlowAtStart(false);
314                if (shroud != null) {
315                        arc.setFadedOutAtStart(true);

317                arc.setWarping(0.2f);

326        @Override
327        public void addPostDescriptionSection(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, HullSize hullSize, final ShipAPI ship, float width, boolean isForModSpec) {
328                float pad = 3f;
329                float opad = 10f;
330                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
331                Color bad = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
332                
333                
334                tooltip.addPara("The \"lens\" (in the loosest sense of the word) focuses on nearby objects, "
335                                + "seemingly at random. Deals %s damage and generates %s flux.", opad, h,
336                                "" + (int) getDamage(hullSize) + " Energy", "" + (int) getFluxCost(hullSize));
337                
338                tooltip.addPara("The rate of fire depends on the size of the ship the "
339                                          + "hullmod is installed on. Can not be turned off during combat operations, and continues to "
340                                          + "function even if the ship is venting flux or overloaded.", opad);
341                
342                //tooltip.addSectionHeading("Reload capacity", Alignment.MID, opad);
343                
344                if (isForModSpec || (ship == null && !Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE)) return;
345                
346                tooltip.setBgAlpha(0.9f);
347                
348                HullSize [] sizes = new HullSize[] {HullSize.FRIGATE, HullSize.DESTROYER, HullSize.CRUISER, HullSize.CAPITAL_SHIP}; 
349                
350                float rofW = 130f;
351                float fluxW = 130f;
352                float sizeW = width - rofW - fluxW - 10f;
353                tooltip.beginTable(Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), Misc.getDarkPlayerColor(), Misc.getBrightPlayerColor(),
354                                   20f, true, true, 
355                                   new Object [] {"Ship size", sizeW, "Attacks / sec", rofW, "Flux / sec", fluxW});
356                
357                for (HullSize size : sizes) {
358                        float rof = getRoF(size);
359                        float flux = getFluxCost(size) * rof;
360                        Color c = Misc.getGrayColor();
361                        if (size == hullSize || Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
362                                c = Misc.getHighlightColor();
363                        }
364                        tooltip.addRow(Alignment.MID, c, Misc.getHullSizeStr(size),
365                                                   Alignment.MID, c, "" + (int) Misc.getRoundedValueFloat(rof) + "",
366                                                   Alignment.MID, c, "" + (int) Misc.getRoundedValueFloat(flux) + "");
367                }
368                tooltip.addTable("", 0, opad);
369                
370                tooltip.addSpacer(5f);
371                
372                addCrewCasualties(tooltip, opad);
373                
374//              if (Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
375//                      return;
376//              }
377        }

391        
392        public CombatEntityAPI findTarget(ShipAPI ship) {
393                float range = MAX_RANGE;
394                Vector2f from = ship.getLocation();
395                
396                Iterator<Object> iter = Global.getCombatEngine().getAllObjectGrid().getCheckIterator(from,
397                                                                                                                                                        range * 2f, range * 2f);
398                int owner = ship.getOwner();
399                CombatEntityAPI best = null;
400                float minScore = Float.MAX_VALUE;
401                
402                //boolean ignoreFlares = ship != null && ship.getMutableStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.PD_IGNORES_FLARES, 0) >= 1;
403                //ignoreFlares |= weapon.hasAIHint(AIHints.IGNORES_FLARES);
404                boolean ignoreFlares = false; // doesn't care one way or another
405                
406                WeightedRandomPicker<CombatEntityAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<>();
407                
408                while (iter.hasNext()) {
409                        Object o = iter.next();
410                        if (!(o instanceof MissileAPI) &&
411                                        //!(o instanceof CombatAsteroidAPI) &&
412                                        !(o instanceof ShipAPI)) continue;
413                        CombatEntityAPI other = (CombatEntityAPI) o;
414                        if (other.getOwner() == owner) continue;
415                        
416                        if (other instanceof ShipAPI) {
417                                ShipAPI otherShip = (ShipAPI) other;
418                                //if (otherShip.isHulk()) continue;
419                                //if (!otherShip.isAlive()) continue;
420                                if (otherShip.isPhased()) continue;
421                                if (!otherShip.isTargetable()) continue;
422                        }
423                        
424                        if (other.getCollisionClass() == CollisionClass.NONE) continue;
425                        
426                        if (ignoreFlares && other instanceof MissileAPI) {
427                                MissileAPI missile = (MissileAPI) other;
428                                if (missile.isFlare()) continue;
429                        }
430
431                        float targetRadius = Misc.getTargetingRadius(from, other, false);
432                        float shipRadius = Misc.getTargetingRadius(other.getLocation(), ship, false);
433                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(from, other.getLocation()) - targetRadius - shipRadius;
434                        if (dist > range) continue;
435                        
436                        float score = dist;
437                        
438                        if (score < minScore) {
439                                minScore = score;
440                                best = other;
441                        }
442                        
443                        picker.add(other, 100f / Math.max(100f, score));
444                }
445                
446                //return best;
447                return picker.pick();
448        }
